title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — Employer Price Schedule
content:
The employer price schedule of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement sets, for each program tier (Paystride Program Starter, Growth, Professional, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus and Strategic), the program charges billed to the employer. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Charges by tier

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly platform fee (USD per month) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 395.00 | 1250.00 | 2950.00 | 6500.00 |
| One-time implementation fee (USD) | 0.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 | 7500.00 | 15000.00 | 25000.00 |
| Signed term at or above which the implementation fee is waived (months) | 12 | 24 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |
| Per-worker monthly fee under the employer-paid fee model (USD) | 4.95 | 4.50 | 3.95 | 3.50 | 2.95 | 2.50 |
| Transfers per worker per pay period with no worker fee under the employer-paid model | 4 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 8 |
| Fee per sponsored instant transfer under the employer-sponsored model (USD) | 2.99 | 2.79 | 2.49 | 2.29 | 1.99 | 1.79 |
| Fee per sponsored next-business-day transfer under the employer-sponsored model (USD) | 0.99 | 0.99 | 0.79 | 0.79 | 0.59 | 0.49 |
| Transfers per worker per pay period whose fee the employer sponsors | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Payroll groups included in the platform fee | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 15 | 30 |
| Monthly fee for each payroll group beyond those included (USD) | 75.00 | 75.00 | 60.00 | 50.00 | 40.00 | 25.00 |
| Discount on the monthly platform fee for a month in which the employer's Payroll Card Program was live on every day (percent) | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 20 | 20 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Monthly platform fee**: the flat monthly platform fee billed to the employer under every fee model.
- **Implementation fee**: the one-time implementation fee billed with the first invoice; it is waived where the signed term, in months, is at or above the waiver term shown for the tier.
- **Per-worker monthly fee**: the per-enrolled-worker-per-month fee billed under the employer-paid fee model; under that model each worker's first transfers in a pay period, up to the number shown, carry no worker fee.
- **Sponsored transfer fees**: under the employer-sponsored model the employer is billed the fee shown for each sponsored instant transfer and each sponsored next-business-day transfer; the employer sponsors the fee of the number of transfers per worker per pay period shown.
- **Payroll groups**: pay schedules or legal entities included in the platform fee, and the monthly fee for each payroll group beyond them.
- **Payroll Card bundle discount**: the discount on the monthly platform fee for a month in which the employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program was live on every day.

## Reading the schedule

A payroll group is a pay schedule or a legal entity set up on the program. On the Paystride Program Growth tier, for instance, two payroll groups are covered by the platform fee and each further group is billed at 75.00 a month; on the Strategic tier thirty groups are covered and each further group is billed at 25.00.
